For any homogeneous solution tensor Ak, the field f(y) = asWave(Ak)(y −x) has normalized jet Ak at order k at x, and zero jets there at all other orders. Thus (GP3) gives P i:di=k pi(Ak) = 0, since k + 2 > 0. Summing over the finitely many jet orders proves that a zero reflected norm annihilates every solution tower. In particular, for any finite alphabet of independent solution-coordinate probes, its one-point reflected matrix is positive definite: evaluate the last identity on a tower with a single basis coordinate equal to one to force each coefficient to be zero. This establishes strictness on the constrained solution spaces themselves, including mixtures of jet orders. We pass from legs to polynomial words algebraically.
